title: NOT IN returns nothing when any order has a NULL CustomerId
description: If the subquery yields a NULL (for example a guest order), NOT IN is never true and the procedure returns no customers; NOT EXISTS does not have this problem.

title: YEAR() on the column prevents an index seek
description: Wrapping OrderDate in a function makes the filter non-sargable, so every order is scanned; a half-open date range can use an index.
